title: Agent chat protocol: drive Claude Code in machine-readable mode, with the relay into another agent's chat
summary: Grillo can now start Claude Code per agent tab in stream-json mode, turn its events into typed chat messages, answer its questions and permission prompts, and relay a message into another agent's chat; verified with a real claude run (question, permission, relay).

deferred.what: A control_cancel_request from Claude Code is ignored, so a cancelled question would leave stale answer buttons on screen
deferred.why: The shape never appeared in a real run, so it was not guessed
deferred.owner: issue #94 (chat view with the show terminal switch)

deferred.what: claude's stderr is ignored, so a start failure reported only on stderr (for example a rejected pinned flag) reaches the chat as a bare exit code 1 with no reason
deferred.why: How a failed start is shown belongs to the chat view
deferred.owner: issue #94 (chat view with the show terminal switch)
